name: Drip
desc: Email and SMS marketing automation for e-commerce

actions.name: apply_tag_to_subscriber
actions.description: Apply a tag to a subscriber

actions.name: add_subscriber_to_campaign
actions.displayName: Add a subscriber to a campaign
actions.description: Add a subscriber to a campaign (Email series)

actions.name: upsert_subscriber
actions.description: Create or Update Subscriber

actions.name: batch_upsert_subscribers
actions.description: Creates or updates up to 1,000 subscribers in one request. Drip processes the batch in the background.

actions.name: delete_subscriber
actions.description: Permanently deletes a subscriber and their history. This cannot be undone.

actions.name: find_subscriber
actions.description: Finds one subscriber by email address or Drip subscriber ID.

actions.name: get_broadcast
actions.description: Gets one Single-Email Campaign (broadcast) by ID.

actions.name: get_campaign
actions.description: Gets one Email Series Campaign by ID.

actions.name: get_conversion
actions.description: Gets one conversion goal by ID.

actions.name: get_current_user
actions.description: Gets the Drip user who owns the API token.

actions.name: get_form
actions.description: Gets one opt-in form by ID.

actions.name: get_workflow
actions.description: Gets one workflow by ID.

actions.name: list_accounts
actions.description: Lists the Drip accounts this API token can access.

actions.name: list_broadcasts
actions.description: Lists Single-Email Campaigns (broadcasts) one page at a time.

actions.name: list_campaign_subscribers
actions.description: Lists the subscribers of one Email Series Campaign one page at a time.

actions.name: list_campaigns
actions.description: Lists Email Series Campaigns one page at a time.

actions.name: list_conversions
actions.description: Lists conversion goals one page at a time.

actions.name: list_custom_fields
actions.description: Lists the custom field identifiers used in the Drip account.

actions.name: list_event_actions
actions.description: Lists the custom event action names recorded in the Drip account.

actions.name: list_forms
actions.description: Lists the opt-in forms in the Drip account.

actions.name: list_subscriber_campaigns
actions.description: Lists the Email Series Campaign subscriptions of one subscriber.

actions.name: list_subscribers
actions.description: Lists subscribers one page at a time, optionally filtered by status, tags or sign-up date.

actions.name: list_tags
actions.description: Lists every tag used in the Drip account.

actions.name: list_workflows
actions.description: Lists workflows one page at a time.

actions.name: record_cart
actions.description: Sends a cart created or updated event to Drip Shopper Activity, e.g. for abandoned-cart workflows.

actions.name: record_event
actions.description: Records a custom event (such as "Logged in") for a subscriber. Workflows and rules listening for it may run.

actions.name: record_order
actions.description: Sends an order event (placed, updated, paid, fulfilled, refunded or canceled) to Drip Shopper Activity.

actions.name: remove_from_campaign
actions.description: Removes a subscriber from one Email Series Campaign, or from all of them when no campaign ID is given.

actions.name: remove_from_workflow
actions.description: Removes a subscriber from a workflow. Nothing happens if they are not on it.

actions.name: remove_tag
actions.description: Removes a tag from a subscriber.

actions.name: start_workflow
actions.description: Starts a subscriber on an active workflow. The workflow may send emails.

actions.name: unsubscribe_subscriber
actions.description: Unsubscribes a subscriber from all Drip mailings.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_subscriber
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscriber is created in your Drip account.

triggers.name: tag_applied_to_subscribers
triggers.description: Triggers when a tag is applied.

triggers.name: completed_campaign
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscriber completes an Email Series Campaign.

triggers.name: custom_event_performed
triggers.description: Triggers when a custom event is recorded for a subscriber.

triggers.name: email_clicked
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscriber clicks a link in a Drip email. Can be high volume.

triggers.name: removed_from_campaign
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscriber is removed from an Email Series Campaign.

triggers.name: subscribed_to_campaign
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscriber subscribes to an Email Series Campaign.

triggers.name: subscriber_deleted
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscriber is deleted from your Drip account.

triggers.name: subscriber_unsubscribed
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscriber unsubscribes from all mailings.

triggers.name: tag_removed
triggers.description: Triggers when a tag is removed from a subscriber.
